summary: Xenia has raised a $12 million Series A funding round. (Scope note: Exact date and lead investor for the round were not confirmed in the source reviewed.)

Xenia serves 300+ organizations across restaurants, retail, convenience stores, hospitality, and manufacturing, including named brands Adidas, Slim Chickens, Zaxby's, and Dave's Hot Chicken; the platform is SOC 2 Type I certified.

Xenia is an AI-powered frontline operations execution app for multi-location businesses, covering digital checklists, task/work-order management, inspections and compliance audits with corrective-action workflows, 24/7 wireless temperature monitoring, team communication, and role-specific analytics dashboards.
